name: Married Women Having Children
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divinely ordained union where a man and woman become one flesh, designed for companionship and mutual support as God created woman to be a suitable helper for man. Within this sacred covenant, God commands married couples to be fruitful and multiply, extending His blessing through the gift of children. Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ's love for the church, while the marriage bed is to remain pure and honorable before God. Together, these truths affirm that married women bearing children participate in God's original plan for family and covenantal faithfulness.
